_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for navigator-sounds-op-ngl, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). The list's detachment (Freeblade Company) is in data.js already, with its gists, mods and defs signed off, so there are no gists or rules here. units: per unit entry, its abilities' When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf), why an ability does nothing in this list (na), its weapon footnotes (mods), help it gives other units when they are attacked (guard), its auras (only what GW tags (Aura), Core Rules 22.01: no ability of this list is tagged (Aura); the Bondsman Duties are tagged (Bondsman), affect only an ARMIGER model, and this list has none), and timing labels where derive.js's reading is not the one the signed-off lists store. Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

_export.note: verify/sources/nr-json/navigator-sounds-op-ngl.json is the owner's New Recruit export with one selection added: the owner forgot to pick a Warlord in New Recruit and said the Warlord is the Cerastus Knight Atrapos (owner's instruction, relayed 25 Oct 2026). The added selection is New Recruit's own Warlord upgrade, as its exports write one (6-bigs.json's Knight Warden): {categories:[Warlord 5c0e-4c31-d51b-e470], name:'Warlord', entryId:'fb98-f509-dbe3-8a3b::ddee-b14f-2f5f-b710::ad65-d3cb-c677-7cb3', number:1, type:'upgrade', from:'entry'}, first among the Atrapos's selections; ddee-b14f-2f5f-b710 is the Warlord link inside the Cerastus Knight Atrapos entry (37a7-d156-1e4c-8fe1) in BSData's Imperium - Imperial Knights - Library at the pin. Its selection id 'nvwrl01' is made up (New Recruit's are random). Everything else is the export byte for byte as JSON (the original's sha256 5a0369f44249f08f264180e8a8ee8018aebf69f19752eb4907f93dedde2f480c).

cerastus-knight-atrapos.why: As 4-megas-and-a-destrier's Atrapos (the same datasheet and enhancement): Bringer of Justice's +2 A is already in the melee profiles (New Recruit's), only its +1 to hit is a footnote. No Atrapos’ Duty aura: it is tagged (Bondsman), not (Aura), and this list has no ARMIGER.

mods.when: Remained Stationary in your Movement phase
mods.note: ranged weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until the end of the turn

knight-crusader.why: As 4-megas-and-a-destrier's Crusader (the same datasheet and enhancement): Hunter’s Eye's [IGNORES COVER] is already on every ranged weapon (New Recruit's), no footnote.

Invulnerable Save (4+*).def: 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks only

mods.note: an unmodified successful hit roll of 4+ scores a Critical Hit

guard.when: Not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of the Knight Defender
guard.note: the Benefit of Cover and a 4+ invulnerable save against that attack

knight-defender.why: Conversion: the conversion beam obliterator's weapon ability (GW's datasheet: "Each time an attack is made with this weapon, if the target is more than 18" away from the bearer, an unmodified successful Hit roll of 4+ scores a Critical Hit"); a condition the player ticks. Selfless Protector: not tagged (Aura), so not an aura; it protects other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models from your army (a guard, as Emanatus Forcefield), not the Defender itself (it cannot be what hides itself). Defender’s Duty: tagged (Bondsman), affects only an ARMIGER model; this list has none.

na.Thundercharge: Needs a thundershock spear and bellatus reaper chainsword: not this loadout

mods.when: Target within range of an objective marker

knight-destrier.why: As 4-megas-and-a-destrier's and 6-bigs's Destrier (the same datasheet and loadout: titanic feet, no thundershock spear or bellatus reaper chainsword).

mods.when: Target is the closest eligible target

knight-errant.why: As 6-bigs's Errant (the same datasheet). Mysterious Guardian: used "At the end of your opponent’s turn" (derive.js's end-opp-turn rule, which reads only a text that opens with it; this one opens "IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. (Once per battle, per army)"), stored as the signed-off Hunters from the Warp and Ambushing Hunters (the same moment, the unit to Strategic Reserves); derive.js reads "your next Movement phase" (where the ingress move it requires is made) as its timing.
